segments.text: Agent docs usually rot because code changes faster than anyone updates the wiki. Open wiki is a CLI that writes that documentation once then keeps it
current. Point it at your repo and it generates a wiki. Then a daily GitHub action opens a PR to refresh it as the code changes. It drops prompting into
your agents.mmd or claw.md automatically so your agent knows to check it
